en: A multi-view vintage postcard showing several scenes from Meissen on the Elbe River. The central image features the twin-spired Gothic cathedral (Dom). Surrounding views include a panorama of the town and river seen from Albrechtsburg Castle, the state porcelain manufactory complex, the town hall on a large square, and a riverside view with Albrechtsburg Castle and the cathedral on the hill above the town. The captions are printed in German.
